violations.description: General employee cleanliness. — --Food employee did not wash hands as necessary. Wash hands in between register and handling consumables.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --In-use utensil was not properly stored during pauses in food preparation or dispensing. Ice scoop stored on top of cooler then placed in ice chest for storage with handle in ice. Store ice scoop in a sanitary method.
Sanitizing solution testing devices. — --Dish rags stored in hand sink, on 3-comparment sink basin. Cleaning rags should be stored in sanitizing solution bucket.

Control of insects, rodents, and other pests. — --Insects, rodents, or other pests were not controlled in a manner specified in the food service code to minimize their presence within the facility. A screen should be provided at door to prevent insects if door is to remain open during operation.

General premises. — --Opening to outside or portion of building that is not part of the food establishment, was not protected against the entry of insects and rodents. Service window not provided with screening.
